description.value:
You overwhelm a creature's mind with a cascade of contradictory impulses. The target must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the target is afflicted with the Fractures of Madness curse: it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4}, cannot Cast Spells, and treats all non-hostile creatures as friendly, following the last spoken order given to it unless compliance would cause self-harm. Removing it requires a successful counteract check against this spell's rank. The target may attempt a new Will save to end the curse at each monthly interval.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute (no curse).

Failure The target is afflicted with the Fractures of Madness curse, as described above.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round before the longer-term curse takes hold.
